result.description: Export a portable .foldasset bundle or import it as a new Composition layer. Export requires document and definition; import requires composition, graph, instance and layer UUIDs. Includes native graphs, Rust source and embedded fonts. External scene/media dependencies must be exposed as inputs. Export never overwrites a file. Import is one undoable transaction and does not execute source. Returns a job; await with jobs wait_ms=25000.
result.name: asset

data.evidence: sampled native evaluated output under two private control overrides; no project mutation
data.limitation: detects exact changes in bounded geometry/paint or uniform field evidence; does not establish the intended magnitude, readability or pixel visibility. Full bounded traversal fingerprints cover elements omitted from the returned sample; hashes are diagnostic, not cryptographic equality proofs. Varying-field and effect evidence is inconclusive; use displacement/direction and rendered comparisons for intended response.

variants.evidence: evaluated geometry; visibility includes effects, masks and clipping only in rendered images

fingerprint.scope: ordered evaluated geometry, transforms, opacity and paint; excludes pixel visibility

variants.space: node output coordinates; depends on upstream construction
